decisive_items: painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath and limited active digit motion
response.rationale: The localized flexor sheath tenderness, fluctuant mass along the A2 pulley region, and limited active digit motion with elevated WBC are characteristic of pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis, whereas septic arthritis and cellulitis do not explain the sheath-specific findings.

rejected.why: Septic arthritis would localize to a joint; the prominent flexor sheath tenderness and A2 pulley fluctuant mass point to the tendon sheath, and radiographs show no fracture/dislocation or joint destruction.
Cellulitis is a superficial skin infection and does not account for the fluctuant mass along the flexor sheath, focal flexor sheath tenderness, or limited active digit motion.
